aspects.description: Crispness, ripeness, rotting, bruising, and overall fruit condition upon arrival
Sweetness, acidity, juiciness, texture, and flavor profile
Fruit size consistency, being too small or 'shriveled', and meeting the advertised net weight
Price fairness, discount/promotion value, and comparison with local markets
Shipping speed, courier service, delivery timing, and transit delays
Packaging condition, protection against damage during transit
Accuracy of product pictures, descriptions, and expectations vs reality
Customer support response time, handling of complaints, returns, and exchanges
